title: Playtest fixes
items: Doors: a big [T] OPEN DOOR / CLOSE DOOR prompt shows when you face a Stone Door, even with a gun in hand, and T works on the selected door in the commander view
The Hollow: you use a station by looking at it from up close - no more using it with your back turned or from odd spots, and never through rock
UNSTUCK in the pause menu: hold still for 5 seconds to return to your Base (cancelled by moving or taking damage; not while carrying a Heartstone or overloaded)
No more falling out of the world: the map edges past the lanes are walled off, and anyone who does fall is put back at the Base
You can no longer stand on walls, guns or other buildings - you slide back off to the side you came from

title: Solid Ground
items: Mining feels instant: your pick swings the moment you press and the rock breaks as the pick lands, even on a laggy connection
Faster picks swing faster: the swing follows your mining speed, down to a half-second minimum
Enemies flash when you hit them, toned down so big fights don't strobe
Mined rocks and new buildings sync more efficiently in big games, and players who join mid-match see the map correctly
When the host leaves, everyone is told why and returned to the Hollow instead of a dropped connection, and nobody can join a game that is closing
RETURN and PLAY AGAIN on the results screen no longer conflict

title: The long game
items: Every player now earns Rime Essence when each day ends, and wisps pay out fairly in groups - progression is much faster, especially in co-op
Skill tree revamp: more levels, new early nodes, new advanced classes (Quartermaster, Stormcaller, Frostcaller), and locked nodes now show exactly what they need
New building: the Stone Door - a wall piece you can open and close; enemies path through it only while it is open
Skip the day: start the next wave early (instant solo, team vote in multiplayer)
Respawn at the Base with a countdown, and PLAY AGAIN on the results screen for the whole party
Base upgrades can be paid in over several trips, and teammates can chip in; anyone can upgrade a teammate's tower
Power is easier to learn: feed towers by holding F, or order it from the commander view
Hold the Hollow (Endless) gets brutal after wave 10, and The Deep is now as tough as surface Insane
Fixes: shop buttons, Esc closes shop screens, menu flicker, guns held properly in third person, RTS mining spots, Jack of All Trades, prices with discounts, resource sync in big games

title: Play together online
items: The host can now remove a player: KICK in the lobby or in pause > PLAYERS, with a confirm. The removed player is sent home with a message and can't rejoin that game.
Mute anyone: MUTE in the lobby or in pause > PLAYERS hides that player's chat on your screen until you leave the game.
Teammates can upgrade each other's towers (the one who upgrades pays); only the builder can sell.
Frost Surge is now a team vote (press Y or N), and only the builder can switch off a Shield Wall's field.
The Base can only be sold when no enemies are coming, and the "I Can Read" achievement needs a finished tutorial (with fireworks).
Winning the tutorial now shows its victory camera and fireworks before the results screen (hosts saw the results at once).
Slowed enemies wear a lighter coat of frost, and the Cryo Mage's orb swirls with violet light.
The Hollow's records wall reads clearly: NIGHTS HELD and "WE KEEP THEIR LAMPS LIT" are now painted lettering.

Safer saves: if a save file is locked by another program (antivirus, a sync tool), your newest progress is kept and picked up the next time you start, and a damaged file is always copied aside before anything is written.

title: First hour
items: New tutorial map: you start next to a safe spot walled in by rock. Break the two gray rocks blocking the way in and build your Base inside.
An on-screen arrow now points to whatever the tutorial asks for (Obsidian, the rocks, the safe spot, your Base), with the distance in metres.
You can skip the tutorial mid-match, and replay the Hollow walkthrough or the first-time hints from Settings.
Your first Tutorial now pays full XP (no more level 3 cap). Replays give no XP.
The first-win bonus is now 150 Rime Essence, and Rime Essence wisps stay on the ground for 150 seconds.
New players are asked what their team should call them. Unnamed teammates show as 'Survivor N', and two players with the same name get '(2)'.
Plainer text: pick upgrades show seconds per hit, trainer points are 'skill points' everywhere, Heartstone sources are listed honestly, and prestige text only appears near the level cap.
After a match a goal points you to the Outfitter, and the end-screen BANKED tile is now CRYSTALS LEFT.
On Easy, a one-time tip warns you when wave 4 starts with no walls, and the wave banner no longer hides tips.
Safer saves: a reset profile stays reset, and a damaged settings or profile file is set aside instead of overwritten.

title: Enemies come alive
items: Every regular enemy and both bosses are now fully animated: they walk, wind up, strike, flinch and die, and their hits land when the blow connects.
Readable attacks: enemies glow and swell as they wind up a hit (easy to spot from the commander view too), the Golem cracks as its armour wears, and boss specials line up with their warning rings.
Hit feedback: ice chips fly off where you hit, big hits stagger enemies, and slowed enemies frost over.
The Almanac's enemy pages show each enemy animated on a stand, with how to spot its attack.
Fixes: the Cryo Mage's hands stay on its arms, the Runner's bite looks natural, your pick swings in your right hand, and the original crystal icons are back.
Boss weak spots now register correctly for every player in co-op.
Big waves run smoother: about 66 fps with 300 enemies at High on an RTX 2080 Ti.
Hollow signs are easier to read, and the same map seed now gives the same waves.
Closed exploits: gun spam, off-map orders and stored-up cooldown bursts.

title: Friends playtest fixes
items: The game is now called Firnreach
Build your Base first: other towers unlock once the team's Base is down
Mouse sensitivity default lowered, with finer 0.1 steps in Settings
Pause menu BROWSE: hover build cards and read tooltips while paused
Clicking a rock in commander view now mines exactly that rock
Animated Ice Brawler and Glacial Runner with readable attack wind-ups
New in the Hollow: Sealed Gate, lift room, records wall, abandoned passage, ice, street furniture and clearer station signs
First-win bonus; leaving a match counts as a loss; easier start on Easy
Key rebinding and accessibility options; new combat effects, snow and boss looks
Fixes: Hollow-return crash, memory leak, stuck bodies, Heartstone kiosk walk

title: Missing art fix
items: Fixed grey checkerboard textures: the Base, Hollow buildings, snow drifts and weapons now show their real art
Mountains render with their painted rock and snow again

title: Wardrobe & Pick Smith
items: New Outfitter fitting room: pick what you wear in each slot, with a free starter outfit
Pick smith rebuilt: choose two tips and a handle, with tiered upgrades
Crystal Radar now reveals hidden crystal seams
Artillery launcher: shells land where you look, with a landing marker
Enemy special attacks are much easier to read at a glance
Esc pauses during a match; adjustable commander pan speed (hold Shift for 2x)
Shop cards with item art, and pick prices rebalanced
Fixes for 8-player parties: everyone sees every enemy, late joiners get a body
New Battery look with visible charge, plus clearer lighting on towers
